inputs.object: DirectionalLight shadow projection, normalBias and filter
inputs.difference: Public Qt directional map fits visible geometry rather than exposing source orthographic bounds (-16,16,-15,15,.1,45). Qt shadowBias approximates world offset; it does not expose separate .035 normalBias / -.0003 normalized bias. PCF16/pcfFactor is not Three PCFSoftShadowMap's bilinear 9-tap algorithm. The isolated raw shadow receiver changes 103255 native pixels versus 61178 source pixels, with peak on/off differences 20 versus 82/255; configuring factor 32 is not evidence of equal effective filtering or intensity.
inputs.acceptance: Compare caster/receiver projection and shadow-only on/off images at 1024/2048/4096. Retain strength .32 and only Optical_Diffuser casters. If public controls cannot align bounds/bias/filter, include explicit shadow target and source filter in the fixed RHI decision.

inputs.object: Unshaded transmission shell shadow reception and overlapping SCREEN_MIP_TEXTURE capture
inputs.difference: The public SHADOW_CONTRIB hook is available to shaded paper but not the existing Unshaded glass algorithm. Low-angle three-case margins diverge while opaque depth/normal probes align. Main SCREEN_MIP_TEXTURE excludes other screen-sampling glass; the isolated single-case fixture cannot prove overlapping-shell parity.
inputs.acceptance: Run R10 overlap/low-spine/intermediate-extraction scenes and measure all five equal-weight ROIs with source cast/receive flags. Resolve capture, sorting and key shadow reception without removing transmission or changing theme/geometry/IOR; select RHI if public Quick3D has a structural limitation.

inputs.object: Opaque alphaTest paper border inside SCREEN_MIP_TEXTURE and geometric MSAA resolve
inputs.difference: Production offscreen MSAA improves shell edge coverage (18 of 23 measured pairs), but the 075 contained print border is still stair-stepped in the screen-space transmission capture. SSAA only partially smooths that capture boundary and expands internal targets; it is a diagnostic, not a production workaround. Keep contain, 1/64 inset, local cover LOD, and print sharpness. The diagnostic 390x844/night SSAA margin ROI (case 047) has MAE 6.101333/255 and no 11x11 SSIM window; other ROI gates must remain strict.
inputs.acceptance: Trace the actual public Quick3D opaque capture and resolve, not just environment MSAA flags. Compare the exact R07 075 direct-material fixture and the nine-size/DPR production pairs. Smooth the print alpha boundary without changing authored geometry, contain or cover contrast/sharpness. Validate hardware/8.3MP limits for any public remedy; if capture sampling cannot be controlled, include multisampled opaque capture plus explicit resolve in the fixed RHI decision. Keep the case-047 diagnostic residual separate from production presets.

inputs.object: Near/far neighboring shells through transmission followed by source Bokeh
inputs.difference: With front camera (0,1.85,12), selected origin (0,0,0), neighboring origins (0,0,4)/(0,0,-4), day/original/guided, the projected background ROI includes the front neighboring shell. Its MAE is 3.448131/255 without Bokeh (078), 3.442029 with Bokeh (079), and SSIM .873666648/.893622447, below .97. Isolated final/raw background ROI is exactly equal (MAE 0), so do not compensate by recoloring or retuning output exposure. Focal/aperture/projection, 41 taps and actual DOF pixel response are independently verified.
inputs.acceptance: Extend the existing R10 overlap/shell-capture probe with these exact near/far origins and camera. Compare opaque capture, glass ordering/capture, scalar depth and pre/post Bokeh separately, retaining all five equal-weight ROI metrics. Resolve neighboring-shell capture differences via public controls or include explicit sorted capture in the RHI decision; preserve geometry/themes/IOR/source optical parameters and the source Bokeh kernel.
